summary: Midweek Serie A keeps Juventus, Milan-or-Draw, Napoli (both legs) and Parma-Udinese both ways, mostly trimmed 1-2pp toward DraftKings for rotation and depleted squads; tennis keeps Mensik, Medvedev (Almaty final fatigue) and Osaka trimmed 2-3pp toward the book averages; esports keeps Spirit and PARIVISION at bookmaker fair price with FURIA trimmed 3pp after Liquid's upsets this week.
